message:
The other day, a storm was brewing, and I could feel my inner parent kicking into high gear. I gathered the flashlights, extra batteries, and a few snacks, while my grandkids were busy arguing over who would get the last cookie. 

I couldn’t help but chuckle as I thought, "What a time to debate dessert!" But I encouraged them to help me instead. We turned it into a game, racing to see who could fill up the water jugs the fastest. 

In the end, we were prepared and had a great time together, which is what really counts. 

What’s your favorite way to involve the kids in getting ready for a storm?
